assertions: New build waits and offers update without reloading or replacing unsaved input.
Deferring the update retains the open editor and text.
Explicit update reload reopens the committed note and isolated storage.
Previous build asset remains available to an older client after removal from server.
A missing close acknowledgement offers explicit reload recovery and reopens committed work.
scope: Real waiting service worker update on headers-free static server; real BrowserHost editing.
limits: No public update or physical iPhone verification.
